name: io.github.taodock-api/mcp-server
title: TaoDock AI Image & Video
description: Discover authorized TaoDock models and generate images or videos from MCP clients.

environmentVariables.name: TAODOCK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS API base URL override; defaults to https://taodock.com/v1. The API key is sent to this endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: TAODOCK_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for generated files; an absolute path is recommended

environmentVariables.name: TAODOCK_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Error message language: en or zh
